draft.subject: Next step in Wrenfield whenever you're ready
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Sorry we missed each other on Monday — no problem at all. Nice work getting your first project set up; projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them.

The usual next step from here is bringing in a teammate — you can invite one from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to pick a time that suits you, or just answer things by email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
